in_hebrew.name: Mignon
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Petite, dainty, dear one
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Mignon הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the French word 'mignon', which means 'delightful' or 'cute'. This name was popular in France during the Middle Ages and was often given to girls. It is a diminutive of the name Marie.

in_greek.name: Mignon
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Petite, dainty, dear one
in_greek.long_meaning: Mignon είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the French word 'mignon', which means 'delightful' or 'cute'. This name was popular in France during the Middle Ages and was often given to girls. It is a diminutive of the name Marie.

in_latin.name: Mignon
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Petite, dainty, dear one
in_latin.long_meaning: Mignon est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the French word 'mignon', which means 'delightful' or 'cute'. This name was popular in France during the Middle Ages and was often given to girls. It is a diminutive of the name Marie.
